\section[em cima]{em cima — above, upstairs}

\label{lesson:PT-C151-em-cima}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for from now on, then the Portuguese for still.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: em cima}
\textbf{em cima} — \textquotedblleft{}above, upstairs\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{em cima} is \textquotedblleft{}on top\textquotedblright{}: \emph{cima}, \textquotedblleft{}top\textquotedblright{} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{cyma}, \textquotedblleft{}young shoot\textquotedblright{}, from Greek \emph{kyma}, \textquotedblleft{}a swelling\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1).
\end{cousinweb}
